ns2:course.label: Dietetics: Professional Issues
ns2:course.description: Discussion of current topics in dietetics, professional issues (ethics, outcomes research, marketing, legislation, registered dietitian exam) and preparing for dietetic internships. Required of all dietetics students. 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing in dietetics.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing in dietetics.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Senior class standing. Restricted to BS:F Sci&Hm Nutr-Diettcs -UIUC.
